text: The Chair of the Improving Access to Housing Working Group will provide an update and share the outcomes of the group’s consultation with the City’s Access to Housing Team on the waitlist system for rent-geared-to-income housing and affordable rental units.

The Housing Rights Advisory Committee: 1. Invited the Centre for Independent Living in Toronto and the GTA Disability Coalition to provide a joint presentation at the September 16, 2025 meeting of the Housing Rights Advisory Committee.
